name: American Black Bear
summary: A defensive mammal recorded in Leonida. It is placed in forest and wetland habitats around Mount Kalaga.
description: The reference page lists the American Black Bear under Hunting, classifies it as a mammal, and reports forest and wetland habitats around Mount Kalaga. It names the Shrewsbury SM-69 as a recommended weapon. These are source-reported details, not independently verified gameplay data.
